title: At small grid item sizes, desktop names don't appear in the pager applet, only "..."
line: The Pager in a horizontal panel now grows wide enough to show full desktop names instead of cutting them to "...".
explanation: The pager sized each desktop cell as panel height times the screen's aspect ratio, so on a normal-height panel a 16:10 cell is only about 60 px wide and names like "Communication" were elided. Plasma 4 widened the pager in horizontal panels to fit the names, but that was never brought back after the QML rewrite. The change measures each label with TextMetrics and, in horizontal panels, makes the cells at least as wide as the widest label (plus a small padding); the applet's width follows. Number labels, "No text", vertical panels and the desktop are unchanged, and window outlines simply stretch horizontally since they are scaled per axis.

commits.message:
applets/pager: grow wider in horizontal panels to fit desktop names

Desktop cells always followed the screen's aspect ratio, so on a normal
panel long desktop names were cut down to a few letters and "...". Cells
in horizontal panels now grow wide enough for the widest label to fit.

BUG: 405454

patches.diff:
From 41b09e95d8b2cd4f6bdb9b0063ba564a78973e90 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:02:29 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/pager: grow wider in horizontal panels to fit desktop
 names

Desktop cells always followed the screen's aspect ratio, so on a normal
panel long desktop names were cut down to a few letters and "...". Cells
in horizontal panels now grow wide enough for the widest label to fit.

BUG: 405454
---
 applets/pager/qml/main.qml | 39 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++----
 1 file changed, 35 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
index b4211ddbbd..c8b47a6c35 100644
--- a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
@@ -32,10 +32,10 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         / ((pagerModel.pagerItemSize.height * pagerItemGrid.effectiveRows)
         + ((pagerItemGrid.effectiveRows * pagerItemGrid.spacing) - pagerItemGrid.spacing)))
 
-    Layout.minimumWidth: !root.vertical ? Math.floor(height * aspectRatio) : 1
+    Layout.minimumWidth: !root.vertical ? Math.max(Math.floor(height * aspectRatio), pagerItemGrid.implicitWidth) : 1
     Layout.minimumHeight: root.vertical ? Math.floor(width / aspectRatio) : 1
 
-    Layout.maximumWidth: !root.vertical ? Math.floor(height * aspectRatio) : Infinity
+    Layout.maximumWidth: !root.vertical ? Math.max(Math.floor(height * aspectRatio), pagerItemGrid.implicitWidth) : Infinity
     Layout.maximumHeight: root.vertical ? Math.floor(width / aspectRatio) : Infinity
 
     Plasmoid.status: pagerModel.shouldShowPager ? PlasmaCore.Types.ActiveStatus : PlasmaCore.Types.HiddenStatus
@@ -174,10 +174,21 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         id: desktopLabelComponent
 
         PlasmaComponents3.Label {
+            id: desktopLabel
+
             required property int index
             required property string display
             required property KSvg.FrameSvgItem desktopFrame
 
+            readonly property real fullWidth: Math.ceil(labelMetrics.advanceWidth) + anchors.leftMargin + anchors.rightMargin + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * 2
+            onFullWidthChanged: Qt.callLater(pagerItemGrid.updateWidestLabelWidth)
+
+            TextMetrics {
+                id: labelMetrics
+                font: desktopLabel.font
+                text: desktopLabel.text
+            }
+
             anchors {
                 fill: parent
                 topMargin: desktopFrame.margins.top
@@ -304,13 +315,32 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
         property int innerSpacing: (effectiveRows - 1) * spacing
         property int rowHeight: Math.floor((root.height - innerSpacing) / effectiveRows)
-        property int columnWidth: Math.floor(rowHeight * pagerItemSizeRatio)
+
+        // In horizontal panels, grow wider so that every label fits
+        property int columnWidth: Math.max(Math.floor(rowHeight * pagerItemSizeRatio),
+                                           Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal ? Math.ceil(widestLabelWidth) : 0)
+
+        property real widestLabelWidth: 0
+
+        function updateWidestLabelWidth(): void {
+            let width = 0;
+            for (let i = 0; i < repeater.count; ++i) {
+                const desktop = repeater.itemAt(i) as DesktopDelegate;
+                if (desktop?.label) {
+                    width = Math.max(width, desktop.label.fullWidth);
+                }
+            }
+            widestLabelWidth = width;
+        }
 
         Repeater {
             id: repeater
 
             model: pagerModel
 
+            onItemAdded: Qt.callLater(pagerItemGrid.updateWidestLabelWidth)
+            onItemRemoved: Qt.callLater(pagerItemGrid.updateWidestLabelWidth)
+
             component DesktopDelegate: PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
                 required property string display
                 required property int index
@@ -319,6 +349,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                 readonly property /*WindowModel*/ var tasksModel: model.TasksModel
                 readonly property string desktopId: (root.isActivityPager ? tasksModel?.activity : tasksModel?.virtualDesktop) ?? ""
                 readonly property bool isCurrent: (index === pagerModel.currentPage)
+                property PlasmaComponents3.Label label
             }
 
             delegate: DesktopDelegate {
@@ -583,7 +614,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
                 Component.onCompleted: {
                     if (Plasmoid.configuration.displayedText < 2) {
-                        desktopLabelComponent.createObject(desktop, {
+                        desktop.label = desktopLabelComponent.createObject(desktop, {
                             index: Qt.binding(() => desktop.index),
                             display: Qt.binding(() => desktop.display),
                             desktopFrame,
--

media.caption: Master, 4 desktops in one row, 46 px panel: names cut to "Develo...", "Comm...".
With the fix: the pager widens and every name is readable.
With the fix, 2 rows: full names with the shrunken font.
